issue_context.title: Process.MainWindowTitle and Process.Responding are not correctly refreshed
comments:
Tagging subscribers to this area: @eiriktsarpalis
Notify danmosemsft if you want to be subscribed.
I've made a test showing the `Process.MainWindowTitle` bug at: https://github.com/JeroenOortwijn/MainWindowTitle-test
@JeroenOortwijn thanks for pointing this out. You are right. Do you want to offer a PR, similar to #32695?

review_comments: Why do we expect MainWindowTitle to start as empty and then be non-empty after a Refresh?

I see this behaviour with the test program that I've written:
https://github.com/JeroenOortwijn/MainWindowTitle-test

With .Net Framework 4.8, the first `Process.MainWindowTitle` call (immediately after Notepad is started) returns an empty string.
As soon as the window is visible, it returns the contents of the window title.

Due to issue #36768, `Process.MainWindowTitle` keeps returning an empty string on .Net Core 3.1 and .Net 5.
